My experience is too good with the own stay.

We really liked the rooms, and the service was very good. The surrounding environment was peaceful, and most importantly, it was a safe environment. Also staff member  was very friendly.
Best place to stay in chhatarpur it was very peace there. Everything was fine. Room and washroom were quite big and very spacious. I really recommend this place.
negative_snippets: The rooms are quite big. But the rooms and washrooms are a little dirty and dust needs proper cleaning. There is no mirror inside washroom. And no basic amenities like soaps,etc. No in-house restaurant or even tea. Although the staff is helpful. The price is on a higher side. Should be around Rs. 1000-1200. Not more than that.
